label: Capture Dense Bash
description: Silently logs shell commands that are hard to read or impossible to allowlist (chained, cd-prefixed, echo-decorated, inline-env, long) to ~/.claude/logs/dense-bash.jsonl, with a best-effort wouldPrompt flag. Observation only — never blocks or rewrites a call. Enable it to gather evidence before deciding which allowlist entries and command-surface rules are worth adopting.
